title: Improve dev delivery checks and test builds
goal: Require successful delivery observations and reduce measured test compilation cost without changing test inventory, dev or release profiles, or native gates.
checkpoint: Scoped candidates pending serialized full native gate. Focused checks and build-profile experiments are not integration, publication, production promotion or an under-60-second end-to-end delivery.

verification.regression: Exact source compiled with pinned rustc and immutable baseline dependencies: original observer 0 passed/1 failed; patched observer 1 passed/0 failed. Real fixture exits 42.
verification.unit_tests: cargo test -p xtask --bin local-channel --offline --locked: 29 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. Final formatted source: 4.66s test phase.
verification.lint: cargo clippy -p xtask --bin local-channel --tests --offline --locked -- -D warnings passed
verification.review: Independent read-only agent review found no blocking issue. Static review confirms all three observations propagate failure before successful delivery evidence writes.
verification.limits: Regression exercises the observation helper, not a complete delivery or rollback transaction. Post-promotion observation failure leaves the new dev selection active and says so. Previous-build observation failure during rollback proof leaves the previous selection active. Full native gate, publication, production qualification and under-60-second delivery remain unverified.
verification.source_guards: Task schema 3, orphan 3, lean ceilings 2 and documentation 5 passed. The previously unavailable architecture test now passed all 41 cases using Cargo-built native-qualified profile16 binaries, and local-channel passed all 29 tests with that profile. Full workspace tests remain pending.

test_profile_experiment.inventory: 197 identical test executable keys per profile; 4679 tracked files restored byte-for-byte after the scoped source-change probe.
test_profile_experiment.limits: Cold target does not mean cold OS caches; incremental measurement covers one owned diagnostic edit, not every change class. Initial interrupted16 run and failed helper setup excluded, preserved in private evidence. Linux independently reports the same direction on a different frozen composition. Full candidate acceptance and end-to-end delivery remain unverified.
test_profile_experiment.method: Compile-only --workspace --offline --locked --features xtask/release-tooling --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-run --message-format=json --timings, separate empty private targets, native sysroot prepare/apply/recheck. Two paired cold-target runs in opposite order. Sysroot preparation measured separately. No compile-probe tests executed.
